name: @zakkster/lite-logn
author: Zahary Shinikchiev <shinikchiev@yahoo.com>
description: Zero-dependency, zero-GC family of O(log n) data structures that proves its logarithm: BinaryHeap (array-embedded O(log n) push/pop min-heap), Fenwick/BIT (O(log n) point-update AND prefix-sum via the i & -i walk), SegmentTree (O(log n) associative range-query + point-update), SkipList (pointer-free expected-O(log n) ordered map over a private free-list node pool), Treap (randomized-balanced augmented ordered map with O(log n) rank/select/split/merge), Scapegoat (DETERMINISTIC weight-balanced augmented ordered map: worst-case-O(log n) get, amortized-O(log n) set/delete, zero-GC rebuild), MinMaxHeap (array-embedded double-ended priority queue: O(1) peekMin/peekMax, O(log n) push/popMin/popMax), SplayTree (self-adjusting ordered map: amortized-O(log n) get/set/delete via top-down splay, hot keys ride near the root, zero-GC), BinomialHeap (mergeable priority queue: O(log n) meld of two heaps over a shared arena, O(1)-amortized push, O(log n) popMin, zero-GC), PairingHeap (ADDRESSABLE mergeable priority queue: O(1) push/meld over a shared arena, amortized-O(log n) popMin/decreaseKey/remove by arena-wide-unique id, zero-GC), and FibonacciHeap (the textbook-optimal ADDRESSABLE mergeable priority queue: O(1)-amortized push/meld/decreaseKey via cascading cuts + a mark bit, O(log n)-amortized popMin/remove via degree consolidation over a shared arena, zero-GC), Fenwick2D (2D BIT: O(log^2 n) point-update AND rectangle-sum via nested i & -i walks), and SegmentTree2D (2D segment tree of segment trees: O(log^2 n) point-update AND general rectangle min/max/sum/gcd fold a 2D BIT cannot do, zero-GC), and SortedArray (read-optimized ordered map over parallel sorted typed arrays: O(log n) get/rank/successor/predecessor, O(1) select/keyAt/valueAt/min/max, O(n) in-place insert/delete), and PersistentSegTree (a FULLY PERSISTENT / branching segment tree via path-copying: update(fromVersion, i, value) returns a new version sharing every off-path subtree in O(log n), any past version stays queryable, over a monotonic bump/append node arena), and MergeSortTree (a STATIC, IMMUTABLE offline range-rank tree: worst-case-O(log^2 n) countLE (how many values <= x in an index range) and rangeCount (count in a value-window) via a segment tree of sorted runs packed into one flat Float64Array, O(n log n) build + space a disclosed co-headline, zero-GC queries), and WaveletTree (a STATIC, IMMUTABLE wavelet matrix over coordinate-compressed values: O(log sigma) access/rank/select and the range ORDER STATISTIC quantile (k-th smallest value in an index range) + rangeCount (value-window count in an index range) via level-wise succinct O(1)-rank bitvectors, n*levels bits + a ~1.25x rank index disclosed co-headline, zero-GC queries), and CartesianTree (a STATIC, IMMUTABLE range-minimum tree via binary-lifting LCA: worst-case-O(log n) rangeMinIndex/rangeMin (the index/value of the extreme over an index range) over a heap-ordered tree built in O(n) with an O(n log n) ancestor table, materialized parent/left/right/depth topology you can walk, RMQ = LCA the teaching bridge, zero-GC queries) with a log-linear O(log n) Witness harness that fits nsPerOp = intercept + slope*log2(n) and shows the straight log line while an O(n) foil leaves it. Tree-shakeable named exports.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run test:types && npm run torture && npm run witness && npm run test:perf
